_comment: The key store: AppleKeyStoreState's NativeKeyStoreEvents (the AppleKeyStore class securityd, keybagd and MobileKeyBag open: its state queries, and the key wrap of kits/droidvm/KeyStoreWrap.inc, selectors 10 and 11), staged and compiled by build-droidvm-legacy-display.py with build-arm-driver.py's own command, and its probe (KeyStoreProbe.cpp), as one kext of the kernel collection. See scripts/build-droidvm-kexts.py.
